_comment: Grow Board settings. READ-ONLY - this app never writes to the POS database. The SQL password is deliberately NOT stored here: release builds are published publicly for auto-update. Enter it once on the Settings page; it is kept per-machine under %APPDATA%\Grow Board.

festivals._comment: The festivals sales revolve around. Deepavali and Ramzan move every year, so Grow Board compares a season with last year's season rather than the same dates. leadDays is how many days of shopping run-up count as the season, festival day included. Dates are the Tamil Nadu observance - check each new year against the government holiday list and add it here. Fixed-date seasons (Aadi, school reopening) need no entry: the same dates last year already line them up. Deepavali 2026 is 8 Nov, confirmed by the shop.

update._comment: Auto-update reads GitHub Releases at https://github.com/vikashpatel04/Grow-board/releases. Set enabled=false to switch updates off.
